multiple stacks of Josephson junctions can be synchronized to emit high power THz-radiations.
“We demonstrate that multiple stacks of intrinsic Josephson Junctions in Bi2Sr2 CaCu2O8+d can be synchronized to emit coherent terahertz waves, with a total power of up to 610 μW at 0.5 THz.”
